SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_order WHERE warehouse_id = #{id}) THEN 'scm.label.purchaseSalesOrder' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_delivery WHERE warehouse_id = #{id}) THEN 'scm.label.deliveryNotice' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_trade_draft WHERE warehouse_id = #{id}) THEN 'scm.label.inboundOutboundDraft' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_trade_draft_item WHERE warehouse_id = #{id}) THEN 'scm.label.inboundOutboundDraft' END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_order WHERE create_by = #{id}) THEN 'scm.label.purchaseSalesOrder' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE create_by = #{id}) THEN 'scm.label.inboundOutboundDocument' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_trade_draft WHERE create_by = #{id}) THEN 'scm.label.inboundOutboundDraft' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_requisition WHERE create_by = #{id}) THEN 'scm.label.purchaseRequisition' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_quotation WHERE create_by = #{id}) THEN 'scm.label.salesQuotation2' END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_quotation WHERE customer_id = #{id}) THEN 'scm.label.salesQuotation2' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_customer_price WHERE customer_id = #{id}) THEN 'scm.label.customerPrice' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_rebate WHERE customer_id = #{id}) THEN 'scm.label.rebateAgreement' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_trade_draft WHERE kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND partner_id = #{id}) THEN 'scm.label.inboundOutboundDraft' END
